name: Camp PGT
description_short: A theatre day camp at The Play Group Theatre in White Plains for ages 4 to 18, with one and two week programs by age group. Younger campers take acting, dance, voice and improv and end each session with a show they help write; older students can add weeks of improv, playwriting, sketch comedy, on camera work or design and tech.

sessions.name: 2 week Session 1 (Little Theatre, PGT Kids, TeenCo)
2 week Session 2 (Little Theatre, PGT Kids, TeenCo)

notes: Summer 2027 runs Monday to Friday, 8:30 to 4. Families can combine one and two week programs into a three or four week summer; a discount applies for both two week sessions. Prices are on the enrollment site, which turned away our fetcher, so tuition is not recorded. One week programs include Improv (July 26 to 30), Playwriting (July 12 to 16), Sketch Comedy (July 5 to 9) and The Pen + The Sword (July 19 to 23).
